    accent=[v for v,c in zip(vals[counts.argsort()[::-1]]),]
    return g
def solve(g):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(g.flatten()); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    acc=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg]
    acc=acc[0] if len(acc)==1 else None
    H,W=g.shape

    out=g.copy()
    for i in range(H):

        if row: out[i]=2
    for j in range(W):
